# plot_period_map { #wass2s.plot_period_map }

```python
plot_period_map(
    data,
    var_key,
    stat,
    start,
    end,
    unit_label,
    ratio=False,
    anomaly=False,
)
```

Single-panel map of a period aggregate, styled from :data:`VAR_CONFIG`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                               | Description                                                                                                                             | Default    |
|------------|------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| data       | xarray.DataArray or xarray.Dataset | Already-aggregated 2-D field (or u/v[/humidity] dataset for vectors).                                                                   | _required_ |
| var_key    | str                                | Variable key defined in :data:`VAR_CONFIG`.                                                                                             | _required_ |
| stat       | str                                | ``"mean"``, ``"sum"``, ``"ratio"`` or ``"anomaly"`` — title only.                                                                       | _required_ |
| start      | datetime.date                      | Window bounds, for the title.                                                                                                           | _required_ |
| end        | datetime.date                      | Window bounds, for the title.                                                                                                           | _required_ |
| unit_label | str                                | Colorbar label.                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
| ratio      | bool                               | If True, render *data* as a percentage-of-normal field using the diverging precipitation-ratio styling (BrBG, 100 % centred).           | `False`    |
| anomaly    | bool                               | If True, render *data* as a departure-from-normal field on a diverging scale centred on zero, using the variable's anomaly levels/cmap. | `False`    |
